name: Burkina Faso

nso.name: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INSD)

latest_census.notes: The 5th RGPH (Cinquième Recensement Général de la Population et de l'Habitation), enumerated Nov-Dec 2019, definitive results 2022. Religion is certain: the packet's national shares (Muslim 63.8%, Catholic 20.1%, animist 9.0%, Protestant 6.2%) are the RGPH 2019 figures. Ethnicity and language spoken (langue parlée / langue principale) were also on the questionnaire, as they were on the 2006 RGPH; the 2019 thematic report on socio-cultural characteristics carries all three. Recalled with good confidence for religion and ethnicity, fair for language.

subnational_sources.title: RGPH 2019 -- Résultats définitifs, rapport thématique 'Caractéristiques socioculturelles de la population' (religion, ethnie, langue) by region, and the per-region 'monographies régionales'
subnational_sources.matches_boundary_level: admin1 (13 regions as drawn: Centre, Centre-Ouest, Est, Hauts-Bassins, Sahel, Sud-Ouest ...)
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled: INSD published the 2019 definitive results as a set of thematic PDF reports and 13 regional monographs on insd.bf; the socio-cultural theme tabulates religion by region, and I believe ethnic group and language likewise. Exact report title and URL not certain; province-level (45) tables may exist inside the regional monographs but I cannot assert it.

subnational_sources.title: RGPH 2006 -- Résultats définitifs, thematic analysis reports (Thème 2: État et structure de la population, and the socio-cultural theme) by region and province
subnational_sources.matches_boundary_level: admin1 (13) and admin2 (45 provinces: Boulgou, Boulkiemdé, Ioba, Kadiogo, Yatenga ... as drawn)
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled: the 2006 census thematic reports tabulated religion and ethnicity down to province, and the 45-province frame has been stable since 1996, so it joins to admin2. Older than 2019 but the only count I can name at the province level.

subnational_sources.title: Afrobarometer Round 9 (already built: fills all 13 admin1 regions)
subnational_sources.evidence: The packet says admin1 religion and ethnicity are filled from an adapter; the repo's Afrobarometer adapter covers BFA (code 5). A survey; any census table above supersedes it.

tier_reason: A 2019 census that asked all three fields and published them by region exists, but as PDF thematic reports whose exact titles and URLs I cannot give; province-level tables are known for 2006 and only possible for 2019. Nothing I can name is CSV/XLSX.
recommended_action: Crawl insd.bf for the RGPH 2019 'résultats définitifs' publications (thematic report on socio-cultural characteristics; 13 regional monographs) and read religion/ethnicity/language by region -- 13 regions = admin1 -- to replace the Afrobarometer survey shares. Then look inside the regional monographs, or fall back to the RGPH 2006 thematic reports, for province tables (45 = admin2). Hazard: in 2025 the government re-cut the 13 regions into 17 with new names (e.g. Kadiogo, Guiriko, Liptako, Goulmou -- recalled, unverified); the census reports are in the 13-region frame the boundary file draws, so prefer those over any re-issued tables.
not_found: A machine-readable (CSV/XLSX) release of the RGPH 2019 socio-cultural tables
Certainty that the 2019 reports break religion/ethnicity down to the 45 provinces
A stable HDX or USCB workbook for Burkina Faso with these fields (the repo's HDX probe did not list one among the 9 read; not known from memory)
summary: Burkina Faso's RGPH 2019 asked religion, ethnicity and language and INSD published them by the 13 regions the boundary file draws, as PDF thematic reports and regional monographs on insd.bf; the 2006 census reports carried the same fields down to the 45 provinces (= admin2). That census count should replace the Afrobarometer survey shares now filling admin1. Tier B because everything I can name is PDF with no certain URL.
